title: Hotel Check-in and Business Stay
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Ahora puedes hacer check-in, pedir lo que necesitas y comunicarte con el personal del hotel en inglés.

parts.visual: Frases para el check-in: I have a reservation (Tengo una reserva). My name is... I would like to check in (Me gustaría hacer el check-in). What time is check-out? (¿A qué hora es el check-out?).
parts.audio: Check-in phrases: I have a reservation. My name is... I would like to check in. What time is check-out?

parts.visual: Solicitudes en el hotel: Can I have a wake-up call at 7 AM? (¿Puede despertarme a las 7?). Could you bring extra towels? (¿Podría traer toallas extra?). Is Wi-Fi included? (¿Está incluido el Wi-Fi?).
parts.audio: Hotel requests: Can I have a wake-up call at seven AM? Could you bring extra towels? Is Wi-Fi included?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la expresión correcta para el hotel.

questions.question: I have a ____. My name is Smith. (Reserva).
I would like to check ____. (Entrar/Registrarse).
questions.explanation: Check in = registrarse a la llegada.

questions.question: I would like a ____ room. (Habitación para no fumadores).
questions.explanation: Non-smoking room = habitación de no fumadores.

questions.question: Can I have a wake-up ____ at 7 AM? (Llamada despertador).
Is ____ included? (Desayuno).
questions.explanation: Is breakfast included? = ¿Está incluido el desayuno?

questions.question: Can I have the ____, please? (Llave / tarjeta de la habitación).
My room is on the ____ floor. (Tercer).
Can I have a ____ room? (Con vista al mar).
questions.explanation: Sea view room = habitación con vista al mar.

questions.question: There is a problem with my ____. (Habitación).
questions.explanation: Problem with my room = problema con mi habitación.

questions.question: Can I ____ my room? (Extender la estadía).
questions.explanation: Extend my stay = extender mi estadía.

questions.question: I need to check ____ early. (Salida anticipada).
Can I leave my ____ at reception? (Maleta/equipaje).
Please add it to my ____. (Factura/cuenta del hotel).
Is there a ____ near the hotel? (Farmacia).
The ____ is on the second floor. (Restaurante del hotel).
Can you call me a ____? (Taxi).
questions.explanation: Call me a taxi = llámame un taxi.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta del hotel.

questions.question: Can I have a wake-up ____? (Llamada despertador).
My ____ is on the third floor. (Habitación).

pairs.source: Please add it to my bill
pairs.target: Por favor cárguelo a mi cuenta

pairs.source: Can you call me a taxi?

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I would like to check in.
options: I would like to check in.
I would like to check out.
She would like to check in.
questions.correct_answer: I would like to check in.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can I have a wake-up call at seven?
options: Can I have a wake-up call at seven?
Can she have a wake-up call at seven?
Could I have a wake-up call at seven?
Can I have a call at seven?
questions.correct_answer: Can I have a wake-up call at seven?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: My room is on the third floor.
options: My room is on the third floor.
My room is on the fourth floor.
His room is on the third floor.
My room is on floor three.
questions.correct_answer: My room is on the third floor.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please add it to my bill.
options: Please add it to my bill.
Please add it to my account.
Please put it on my bill.
Add it to my bill please.
questions.correct_answer: Please add it to my bill.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can I leave my luggage here?
options: Can I leave my luggage here?
Can she leave her luggage here?
Could I leave my luggage here?
Can I leave my bags here?
questions.correct_answer: Can I leave my luggage here?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you call me a taxi?
options: Can you call me a taxi?
Could you call me a taxi?
Can she call me a taxi?
Can you get me a taxi?
questions.correct_answer: Can you call me a taxi?
